name: DOB After Hour Variance Permits
description:
This dataset contains records of after-hours variance permits issued for construction work in New York City. Each row represents a permit allowing work outside standard hours, with details on the property location (BIN, house number, street name, borough, community board, council district, census tract, NTA neighborhood, and latitude/longitude), the associated work permit and after-hours variance permit numbers, permit status, variance type (initial or renewal), and the stated reason for the variance, such as city construction projects, public safety, emergency work, or undue hardship. It also records the start and end date-times of each variance and flags for nearby residences within 200 feet, enclosed work, demolition, and crane use.

The data can be used to analyze where and when after-hours construction is permitted across the city, which boroughs and neighborhoods see the most activity, how often variances are requested for public safety versus hardship reasons, and the typical duration and timing of permitted work. It could support urban planning and noise
